description: On-brand visual work: capture a brand once, then build real PowerPoint decks and print-ready marketing flyers in that brand, with logo, colours and fonts applied.

prerequisites: Your logo as a PNG file, and your brand colours if you know them
first-value.starter-task: Capture your brand once, then make a flyer in it
first-value.starter-prompt: Set up our brand kit from this logo (./brand/logo.png) and these colours: #0E5A46, #F2A541. Then make a Letter-size flyer for our community health fair on Saturday 14 November, 10am–2pm, at Riverside Park.
first-value.verification: brand-kit writes brand.json and a one-page BRAND.md with contrast checked, and marketing-flyer writes flyer.html in your colours with your logo, one call to action, and only the facts you gave it.
first-value.recovery: If the flyer comes out in default colours, check that marketing-flyer was given the brand.json path. If brand-kit does not activate, ask for it by name ("use brand-kit").

journey.when: You need a deck or a flyer in your own branding and do not want to answer the brand questions every time.
you_bring: your logo as a PNG, and a white version if you have one
brand colours, fonts or a PowerPoint template, if you know them
the content: the doc or points for the deck, and the event facts for a flyer
the audience and how long you have to present

steps.you_do: Hand over your logo, colours and any brand guidelines or template.
steps.you_get: A brand.json and a one-page BRAND.md, with text contrast checked and each value traced to where it came from.

steps.you_do: Give it the content, the audience and the time slot.
steps.you_get: A slide-by-slide outline with takeaway titles, key points, speaker notes, backup slides for likely questions, and a slide-count check against the time.

steps.you_do: Hand it the outline, the audience and your brand.json.
steps.you_get: An editable .pptx in your brand, with charts, tables and images where the content calls for them.

steps.you_do: Run it on the deck against the deck rubric, as deck-builder recommends.
steps.you_get: A verdict and severity-tagged findings with a fix for each.
steps.decide: Ship the deck, apply the changes, or rework the outline.

steps.you_do: If you also need a flyer, give it the event facts and the same brand.json.
steps.you_get: A print-ready flyer.html with one call to action and only the facts you gave it, which you can save to PDF.

journey.you_end_with: A reusable brand kit, a reviewed on-brand .pptx, and optionally a flyer built from the same brand.
